question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Final query: bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, 
    COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN e.extra_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
    ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b 
    ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY (1.0 * br.total_runs / bw.wickets) ASC
LIMIT 1;
